review_contract: Read all 15 indexed source files, not only their summaries.

Record the review date, reason and any newly recovered nuance here.

newly_recovered_nuances: The architecture taxonomy is a search library, not a linear ranking.
The Physics of Models method requires behavior probes and internal or mental probes together.
Architecture creation uses constrained recombination, multiple sketches, hit selection and mechanism deconvolution.
Qualitative plot observations must be preserved because aggregate statistics can erase failure morphology.
A positive probe establishes decodability, not causal use; a negative restricted probe does not establish total information absence.
Information presentation can determine learnability even when a solution exists in the nominal function class.
A component that computes a useful intermediate feature may still fail as part of a larger scaffold because later stages erase or fail to use it.
